title: Glass side panel
text: Tempered glass so the build is on show. We route every cable behind the tray, so the view stays clean.

title: Case fans
text: Pull cool air in at the front and push warm air out the back. We tune the fan curves so it stays quiet at your desk.

title: Motherboard
text: The board every part plugs into. We pick one with the ports, Wi-Fi and upgrade room you'll actually use.

title: Processor
text: The CPU runs everything you do. Gaming builds favour fast cores; editing and workstation builds favour more of them.

title: CPU cooler
text: Keeps the processor cool and quiet under load. Every build runs a 24-hour stress test before it leaves the shop.

title: Memory
text: RAM holds what you're working on right now. 32 GB covers most people; video editing and 3D want 64 GB or more.

title: Storage
text: The NVMe SSD where Windows, games and files live. It boots in seconds, and we set up backups so nothing is lost.

title: Graphics card
text: Draws every frame in games and speeds up video and AI work. Usually the biggest single part of the budget.

title: Power supply
text: Feeds steady power to every part. We size it with headroom and fit 80+ Gold or better, never a no-name unit.
